elements.element: The obligations apply upon either expiry or termination of the agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3 applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”
HDI must “provide reasonable transition assistance” at the Company's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for up to six months following expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Assistance is provided “for a period of up to six (6) months following the Termination Date.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly states “at HDI's then-current rates.”

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: HDI must “return to the Company all Content, user information and customer data of the Company then in HDI's possession or control.”

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Return is required “within thirty (30) days after the Termination Date,” under the provision triggered by expiration or termination.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The returned data must be “in a standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: Vendor deletes the returned Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) requires HDI to “thereafter delete all such Content, user information and customer data from its systems.”

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of the Customer Data after deletion.
elements.evidence: HDI must “certify such deletion to the Company in writing.”

elements.element: The obligations apply upon either expiry or termination of the agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3 applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”
HDI must “provide reasonable transition assistance” at the Company's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for at least 90 days following expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause permits requested assistance for up to six months, which includes the fallback 90-day period.

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: HDI must return to the Company all Company Content, user information, and customer data in its possession or control.

elements.element: Vendor completes the data export within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The operative clause requires return in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after the Termination Date.

result.reason: The operative addition satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also the fallback. It covers expiration and termination, six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, data return within 30 days in a standard machine-readable format, subsequent deletion, and written certification. The existing termination-payment provision is unchanged, and no unrelated commercial obligation is added.
